title: AirCompKit: a security-aware simulator for over-the-air computation and over-the-air federated learning
description: AirCompKit is an open-source Python simulator for over-the-air computation (AirComp) and over-the-air federated learning. It models the channel, the AirComp transceiver (power control and receive beamforming), the learning loop, an explicit threat model with physical-layer attacks, and defences such as grouped robust aggregation, and it reproduces published results with tolerance checks.
